lastFeature: 0.5.44 milestone-badge-dark-contrast (fix) BUILT + VERIFIED + RECORDED + COMMITTED on the VM (session 49), pushed main + tag v0.5.44. PENDING the Mac release. Bug: on the Statistics tab the Firsts & Milestones badges (and the Frivolous Lists CompletionBadge, which shares the tokens) rendered as bright near-white tiles in dark mode with the species name invisible -- the [data-theme=dark] --sr-milestone-* block was a verbatim copy of the near-white :root tiles, and the name (the only badge element not bound to a milestone token) inherited the theme-flipping --sr-text. Fix (scope B, user choice): re-tinted the dark-theme --sr-milestone-* tokens to dark tiles (deep green tiers 1-3, deep amber tier 4) with number/name/date/check/border all re-tuned to WCAG AA against BOTH gradient stops; pure CSS token change in frontend/src/globals.css, NO component code; light mode (:root) untouched. Added frontend/src/lib/milestoneContrast.test.ts (parses the real dark tokens, asserts AA -- would fail on a re-copy of light tiles; reads globals.css via a file-scoped /// <reference types=node /> + fs because vitest stubs CSS ?raw). CI mirror green (lint + typecheck + 1006 vitest incl. 28 new + build; entry chunk ~218 KB unchanged, vendor-maplibre isolated). Security pass clean (no new surface; static CSS values). User approved dark+light screenshots rendered from the built CSS. Versions bumped 0.5.44 (frontend/package.json + src-tauri/tauri.conf.json + frontend/package-lock.json); CHANGELOG entry; Chronicler updated DECISIONS (post-mortem) + CLAUDE.md (intentionally-light-surface rule) + ROADMAP (shipped 79); PRODUCT_CONTEXT unchanged (restored behavior, no new capability).
